ExpiryItem.title: ExpiryItem
ExpiryItem.description: A household food, medicine, daily care, or other item tracked for expiration.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the item owner.

name.description: Trimmed display name of the item (1..120 chars).

category.description: Item category matching original baozhiqi schema.

expiry_date.description: Local expiration date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

note.description: Optional non-empty note; omitted when blank.

used_up.description: Whether the item has been used up and archived.

created_at.description: Creation server timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updated_at.description: Last modification server timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

UserReminderSettings.title: UserReminderSettings
UserReminderSettings.description: Per-user local reminder schedule and language preferences.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

remindersEnabled.description: Whether local expiry notifications are enabled.

createdAt.description: Creation server timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last modification server timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/items/{itemId}.description: Top-level collection of expiry items isolated by ownerId == request.auth.uid.

/user_settings/{userId}.description: Per-user reminder and language settings keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
